correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed two strictly increasing piecewise-linear quantiles; their difference is 0, then increases with slope 8, then remains 8/5, proving X<=disp Y for every pair of quantile levels. Independently integrated quantile pieces to get tau_X=(25p²+143)/(2(25p²-25p+86)) and tau_Y=(25p²+183)/(2(25p²-25p+106)) on [3/5,4/5]. At u=24/25 and v=159/164, with u<v, differences are 174/115 and (1411-sqrt(62841))/770 respectively; 62841*23²-5657²=1241240>0 verifies reversed required strong expectile gap. Exact algebra checks the single witness; no finite enumeration used as a universal proof.
